messages:
rachel: Quick design sync 1: I ran the Hostname & DNS probe flow with a few flaky lab networks. Posting notes + a short Figma clip: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE. Goal: make probe results easier to scan and act on for non-network engineers.

dan: Nice. First UX issue I saw: pass/fail pills use green/red without icons. Low-vision users need shape + text. Add an icon (check/x) and ensure contrast ratio >= 4.5:1.

lee: Agree. Also group results by severity: Critical (blocker), Warning (may work), Info (diagnostic). Show suggested next steps inline for Critical items so the user can click 'Fix guide' or 'Skip & continue'.

tom: For copy: avoid jargon. Instead of 'NXDOMAIN' show 'Hostname could not be resolved' and then on hover/explain: 'The DNS lookup returned no result (NXDOMAIN). Check your DNS records or contact your network admin.' Keep the tooltip under 140 chars.

rachel: UX detail: when multiple tests fail, collapse low-priority fails by default but surface a summary line like '3 tests failed, 1 critical'. Expandable list should preserve keyboard focus and announce changes.

aria-bot: a11y checklist: 1) result list must be a semantic list (<ul>) with each item role='listitem'; 2) status updates use aria-live='polite' for incremental messages; 3) color not sole indicator: include text and icon; 4) ensure focus trapping not used when popovers open.

lee: Visual suggestion: use a left-aligned status column with compact icons + short label. Main body uses two-line summary (one-line title + one-line action hint). On mobile compress to single line with chevron.

tom: Edge case copy: TTL-expired warnings are confusing. Proposed copy: 'DNS records found, but TTL is low (under 60s). This may cause transient failures during setup. Consider increasing TTL to 5min+'.

rachel: Good. Also a data/privacy note: do not log full queried hostnames in hosted logs. For Private deployments, make hostname hashing configurable and default-on. Product wants a boolean event 'dns_probe_failure=true' not the raw name.

ci-bot: Integration test note: I pushed a unit test that fakes a DNSError and checks UI grouping. Failing on color token lookup in dark mode. Stacktrace in CI: https://ci.example/repo/123

dan: For dark mode colors, reduce saturation and increase lightness for the success token. I'll post updated tokens in Figma. Also add high-contrast variant for OS-level contrast setting.

rachel: Acceptance criteria for the ticket I will open: 1) semantic list + aria-live updates; 2) icons + text for pass/fail; 3) grouped severity with expandable low-priority; 4) revised copy for NXDOMAIN and TTL; 5) telemetry flag only (no raw hostnames) and privacy note; 6) CI green in both light/dark.

lee: I'll mock the expanded behaviour and keyboard flows. Planning to run a 20-min usability test with two non-network PMs tomorrow.

tom: Ill draft the tooltip short/long variants and paste here by EOD. Also adding an example remediation link for 'Fix guide'.

aria-bot: Reminder: when announcing '3 tests failed, 1 critical', use role='status' and include a short label so screen readers don't read long technical strings.

rachel: Thanks all. Ill open the ticket after the lab and tag eng/runtime + eng-sre. If we can get the CI fix in the same PR that would be ideal.
